import bpy,json,hashlib,os,datetime
from pathlib import Path
ns=bpy.app.driver_namespace['submerge16'];cap=ns['cap'];project=ns['root'].parents[1]
assert not bpy.data.is_dirty
manifest=json.loads((cap/'delivery_manifest.json').read_text('utf8'))
for relative,info in manifest['files'].items():
 assert hashlib.sha256((project/relative).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==info['sha256'],relative
report={'pid':os.getpid(),'file':bpy.data.filepath,'source_saved':not bpy.data.is_dirty,'manifest_files_verified':len(manifest['files']),'quit_requested':True,'time':datetime.datetime.now().isoformat()}
(cap/'session_close.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2),encoding='utf8')
print('SUBMERGE16_DELIVERY_VERIFIED',report)
bpy.app.timers.register(lambda:bpy.ops.wm.quit_blender(),first_interval=1.0)
